1.name: Trading With Pixies

effects.text: Spend any number of resources, except {sword}, to mark 1 {mark} for every 7 resources spent. When complete, {flip}.
End of Turn: If you haven't marked any {mark} this turn, destroy 1 friendly card in discard pile.

4.name: Invisibility Cloak

effects.text: When purged, this is worth double {fame}.
Mark 1 {mark} below to discard all negative cards in play and in your deck, then reshuffle the deck.

4.text: {triggeredOptional} When purged, this is worth double {fame}. {activated} Mark 1 {mark} below to discard all negative cards in play and in your deck, then reshuffle the deck.

description: This is 1 of the 10 adventures you can choose on your Adventure Map. Once you have started making business with them, do not neglect the Pixies - the rewards can be great, but they do not take disrespect lightly...
